research_question: Which gradient-calibrated same-source instruction-ranking bundle is the better candidate for a later time-matched causal test, while preserving held-out Edit fidelity, T2M, and Kimodo-like control?

training.paired_stream: same seed, plans, data rows, augmentation, t, noise, source condition, and sibling text
training.treatment_difference: hinge multiplier 1.0 versus temperature-0.01 softplus multiplier 0.575; calibrated to match initial output-gradient RMS within 2.4 percent, not claimed as a pure loss-shape ablation

evaluation.primary_subset: held-out target-disjoint exact-same-source sibling groups, deterministically pruned so no exact source/target asset appears in two bootstrap units

control_guardrail.exact_overwrite_invariant: torch.equal exact_clamped[mask], observed[mask] for every case

edit_success_requires: positive parent-relative mean delta in t=0 full-273 assignment_advantage
no more than 5 percent parent-relative degradation in t=0 correct_instruction_mse
matched-noise ODE32 correct instruction is not worse than empty instruction on mean target MSE
no more than 5 percent parent-relative degradation in matched-noise raw ODE32 correct_instruction_mse
decision_rules.relative_degradation: directional (candidate-parent)/max(abs(parent),1e-8), sign-adjusted so positive is worse
decision_rules.t2m_guardrail: all frozen same-seed raw physical metrics must remain within 5 percent; visual semantics reviewed separately
decision_rules.control_guardrail: all frozen raw adherence metrics in both text regimes must remain within 5 percent; exact observed-channel overwrite must pass every case
decision_rules.selection: among arms satisfying every guardrail, use the direct paired bootstrap of softplus-minus-hinge held-out t=0 assignment_advantage; select one only if its CI excludes zero, otherwise report both

interpretation_limits: The 5K pilot selects an instruction-supervision mechanism; it is not a final MotionFix benchmark claim.
Without a time-matched 405K no-rank arm, parent-relative changes cannot establish that ranking beats ordinary continuation.
Assignment can improve by worsening sibling-text outputs, so correct-instruction MSE and ODE fidelity are mandatory guardrails.
t>0 fixed-state results are supportive because target information is present in z_t.
EMA is secondary because 5K updates are short relative to the EMA horizon.
